author: KEXP
description:
Under the musical project Sadness, Damian Anton Ojeda draws on nostalgia through black metal and atmospheric soundscapes.

Watch him perform "In The Distant Travels" & more in our latest Live on KEXP in-studio session.
title: Sadness performs "In The Distant Travels" & more Live on KEXP
